Sandeep↗

I like making things that move
from “what if” to “it’s live.”

My work spans career platforms, admin applications, fashion, and AI. I’ve built EleWin, ChinarAgro’s Admin App, and Mahavir Fashion, and contributed to OneBrain and IIT Kanpur’s Students’ Placement Office website.

The common thread? Turning an idea into something tangible, useful, and considered. Sometimes independently. Sometimes alongside a team.
